verdict.rationale: The evidence shows official client-side JavaScript SDKs: the quickstart is built on Airwallex.js, the AI-agent instructions recommend `@airwallex/components-sdk` over the legacy `airwallex-payment-elements`, and the Drop-in Element is created via `createElement(...)`. Nothing shows official server-side or backend-language SDKs, so building against SDKs is evidenced only for the front-end checkout layer. Missing for 10: official server-side SDKs (e.g. Node, Python, Java), SDK reference docs or versioning info, and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
